summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications dated November 12, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or abrupt leadership change is disclosed in the excerpt; exhibits are ordinary periodic reporting items incorporated into the Form F-3 shelf. Disclosed items reference a Hedia acquisition and a Bank Hapoalim facility in the notes, but no new special-situation event is announced. Nothing for deal-risk arbitrage; watch ordinary quarterly results and financing disclosures.
